name: Pálfa (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue in the ratio 1:4:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pálfa (a blue shield with a white church, a tree and a wavy stripe) above a scroll inscribed PÁLFA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
